email.subject: Request for help
email.body: The cookbook skips from page 32 to 49. The binding is intact and it arrived sealed. Can you check whether this is a printing issue and how to request a copy with all pages?

expressed_evidence: Can you check whether this is a printing issue and how to request a copy with all pages?

how to request a copy with all pages

The binding is intact and it arrived sealed.
Can you check whether this is a printing issue and how to request a copy with all pages?

uncertainty: Whether the missing pages constitute a printing defect or a different edition is not established; the customer asks for verification.
No explicit dissatisfaction is expressed, so complaint intent is inferred only from the request for a corrected copy.

slot.reply:
I'm sorry the cookbook you received is missing pages 32–49; I understand how frustrating that is with a sealed, intact copy. Your report of the gap is noted, but I can't yet confirm from here whether it is a printing fault or how a replacement would be handled.

An internal aftersales verification request has been created and is pending. It covers checking the printing issue and the applicable inspection, repair or replacement conditions. This is a pending internal request only; no assessment has started and no outcome is confirmed.

To let the check proceed, please reply with your order number (or the order reference from your confirmation email). If you have a photo showing the jump from page 32 to 49, that would help confirm the defect, but the order reference is the key item needed first.

Once the order is located, the official aftersales channel for that order can confirm whether a complete copy can be requested, along with any return, fee or timing conditions. Please keep the book as received for now rather than altering or discarding it. You're welcome to ask for progress on the pending request at any time.
